technical_and_design_decisions: Refactor module deployment from static repository abstractions into a pluggable runtime Service Provider Interface (SPI) to support multiple deployment backends.
Design the standalone Boot-based ModuleRunner as a lightweight execution container that loads and executes modules without requiring full xd-container daemon setup.
Implement an automatic parameter handling and escaping layer within the GPDB integration to simplify command line and configuration UX.
Utilize JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) or Spring benchmark suites to systematically evaluate and isolate bottlenecks in TupleBuilder and jdbchdfs pipelines.
assumptions: Development and testing will take place on Java 17+ compatible Spring XD and Spring Boot infrastructure.
Test environments with access to Greenplum Database (GPDB), SQL Server, Kafka, and HDFS/Hadoop instances are available for benchmark and validation tasks.
The DEBS challenge requirements are well-defined and only implementation completion, optimization, and submission packaging remain.
A single software developer will perform all implementation, configuration, benchmarking, and verification tasks.

activities.activity_description: Finalize remaining algorithmic logic, verify performance against benchmark datasets, and package the solution for DEBS submission (U1).

activities.activity_name: CI Pipeline Configuration for Install Target
activities.activity_description: Update CI build configuration to execute the 'install' target and verify build artifacts to reduce local verification overhead (U2).
Clean up, document, and publish the Spring XD and Kafka integration proof-of-concept into the samples repository for reference architecture use (U3).
Revisit and re-run performance benchmarks to evaluate recent optimizations around jdbchdfs data ingestion and transfer pipelines (U4).
Construct dedicated benchmark test cases for TupleBuilder, analyze CPU/memory bottlenecks, and apply targeted performance optimizations (U5).

activities.activity_name: GPDB Parameter UX Simplification & Sqoop Comparison
activities.activity_description: Simplify parameter handling for GPDB by removing manual escaping requirements, and test Sqoop jobs comparing UX and performance across SQLServer and GPDB (U6).
Decouple module deployment from the stream/job definition repository abstraction and re-architect it into a pluggable runtime SPI (U7).
Develop an isolated Spring Boot-based ModuleRunner for container-managed runtime environments, removing mandatory dependence on xd-containers (U8).
Perform comprehensive regression and integration testing across updated deployment SPIs, ModuleRunner, and CI pipelines.
